name: reseassistenten
description: Connect ChatGPT or Codex to ReseAssistenten: read your trips, bookings, travel documents and travel-planning intelligence on your behalf, with exactly the permissions you have on the web.

interface.shortDescription: Plan trips on your own ReseAssistenten travel data.
interface.longDescription: Connect ChatGPT/Codex to your own ReseAssistenten account: plan SAS award trips, run Resekontroll, coach your EuroBonus status and explore award-winning destinations. Declares the hosted, per-user-authenticated MCP server at https://reseassistenten.se/mcp as a remote server. On first use your browser opens for OAuth login + consent on ReseAssistenten (dynamic client registration) — no tokens or secrets are stored in this plugin. The agent acts with exactly the permissions you have on the web.
